items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: Yeah, I worked Silhouette Club with him, and I worked at Garrick Bar with him, and I worked at Club Rio with him

ctx.x: Well, let's see. Now, let's see. Sir Oliver Bibbs, how many jobs did you play with him? Play many places with him?

Yeah, I worked Silhouette Club with him, and I worked at Garrick Bar with him, and I worked at Club Rio with him, and I worked at, what was it? Martin's Condor. Martin's Condor. Mm-hmm. On the west side with him. That's in Chicago. Oh yeah. Oh yeah. Oh, Chicago. And that Silhouette Club is a beautiful place. On Harvard Street. Well, when did you first start going on the road then? When I left with Miramac Miramacos. First trip I took.
No, I mean after you were in Chicago. Huh? After you were in Chicago. Well. Things started getting slow, you said.
